# 5 bed detached house for sale

> A substantial 5-bedroom detached property (former Public House) situated at Main Street, Ballindine, Co. Mayo. It is situated at the centre of Ballindine village close to all schools, shopping centre, restaurants, church etc. It extends to circa .624 sq.mt. The property is presented in poor condition and requires complete renovation internally.
